fields.statement: The ArgentSea Core NuGet package embeds readme.md and argentsea-logo.png at the package root (PackagePath "\\"). Separately, the compiled assembly declares InternalsVisibleTo for $(MSBuildProjectName).Test (i.e. ArgentSea.Test), so members with internal visibility in ArgentSea Core are reachable from that one test assembly and from no other consumer of the published package.
fields.scope: ArgentSea Core package content items and internal-visibility grant (ArgentSea.Shared/src/ArgentSea.csproj ItemGroup).
